cross-border-document-continuity.term: Could the airline transfer my visa details without exposing the rest of my passport?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 航空公司能否只转交我的签证信息，而不泄露护照的其他内容？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: My renewed passport has a different number; which bookings must I update first?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 我的新护照号码变了，我应该先更新哪些预订？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: If border officers keep the original letter, will a certified copy support my onward journey?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 如果边检人员收走原件，认证副本能否支持我继续旅行？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Does my two-country visa remain valid during an overnight transit?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 签证覆盖这两个国家，但在过夜转机时仍然有效吗？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Which document proves that my previous surname and current passport belong to the same person?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 哪份文件可以证明我的曾用姓和现护照属于同一个人？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Because the entry stamp is unclear, could you record where and when I arrived?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 由于入境章不清楚，您能记录我的入境地点和时间吗？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Would a digital residence permit work if the border system cannot retrieve my profile?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 如果边境系统无法调取我的资料，电子居留许可还能使用吗？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Before I surrender this passport, how can I preserve evidence of my valid visas?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 交回这本护照前，我该如何保留有效签证的证明？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: My twenty-four-hour transit exemption requires me to remain inside the designated area.
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 我的过境豁免适用二十四小时，前提是我留在指定区域内。

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Can the consulate link my emergency passport to the visa stored under the old number?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 领事馆能否把我的紧急护照与旧号码下的签证关联起来？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Although my permit is valid, the airline cannot verify it through its own database.
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 虽然我的许可仍有效，但航空公司无法通过自己的数据库核验。

cross-border-document-continuity.term: What evidence should I carry if my return authorization is approved after departure?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 如果我的返程许可在离境后才获批，我应该携带哪些证明？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Since the booking omits my middle name, will matching birth details resolve the discrepancy?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 由于预订中漏了我的中间名，出生信息一致能解决这个差异吗？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Could you compare the entry requirements for the direct route and the connecting route?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 您能比较直飞路线和转机路线的入境要求吗？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Where can I request correction of the wrong date on my border receipt?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 边境回执上的日期错误，我可以在哪里申请更正记录？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: If my visa expires during treatment, what document would protect my permitted stay?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 如果我的签证在治疗期间到期，哪份文件可以保障我的合法停留？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: May I present verified copies with an inventory instead of carrying every original?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 我可以不携带所有原件，而是提交核验副本和文件清单吗？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: How can our family relationship remain traceable across my child's separate passport?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 我的孩子使用另一本护照旅行，怎样才能持续证明我们的亲属关系？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Does this temporary certificate support both departure and re-entry?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 这份临时证明只适用于离境，还是也能支持再次入境？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Please note why the document was rejected and what evidence would address that reason.
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 请注明文件被拒的原因，以及什么证明可以解决该问题。

cross-border-document-continuity.term: The officer needs a clear link between my attached translation and its original.
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 译文已经附上，但工作人员需要看到它与原件的明确对应关系。

cross-border-document-continuity.term: When two databases show different expiry dates, which record should the carrier rely on?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 当两个数据库显示不同的到期日时，承运方应该依据哪一条记录？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Would presenting my approval email help while the updated permit remains unavailable online?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 更新后的许可尚未能在线查询时，出示批准邮件是否有帮助？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: The application reference works, but my confirmation page disappeared after the system update.
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 申请编号仍然有效，但系统更新后我的确认页面消失了。

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Can you add the passport replacement receipt so the entire document trail stays connected?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 您能补充护照更换回执，让整条文件记录保持连贯吗？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Does conference attendance remain permitted under my non-employment entry conditions?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 我的入境许可不包含工作，参加会议是否仍符合其条件？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: If this exception does not apply, which route lets me travel without losing the booking?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 如果这项例外不适用，哪条路线能让我出行又不损失预订？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: The name order differs across documents, although every identifying number matches correctly.
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 不同文件中的姓名顺序不同，但所有身份号码都完全一致。

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Could the desk verify my supporting documents before I join the immigration queue?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 服务台能否在我排入边检队伍前核对我的辅助材料？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Keep the cancellation notice with the replacement permit so later officers can follow the sequence.
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 请把取消通知和替代许可放在一起，方便后续工作人员了解完整过程。

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Where should I report a missing entry record before it affects my departure clearance?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 我应该在哪里报告缺失的入境记录，以免影响离境手续？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Unless the printed authorization is accepted, I may miss the only permitted connection.
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 除非打印的授权书被接受，否则我可能错过唯一允许的转机。

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Can my travel companion submit the document while I remain at the inspection counter?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 我留在检查柜台时，同行人可以替我提交文件吗？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: The correctly issued permit has a machine-readable code unable to scan.
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 许可签发无误，但机器可读码无法扫描。

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Which supporting record best explains the gap between my two periods of authorized stay?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 哪份辅助记录最能解释我两段获准停留期之间的空档？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: After the appeal succeeds, how will the correction reach the airline and border database?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 申诉成功后，更正信息将如何同步到航空公司和边境数据库？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: I need a single timeline of submissions plus responses and remaining actions.
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 我需要一条时间线，列明每次提交、回复、替换和待办事项。

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Could you confirm whether the exception covers my nationality, destination, and exact transit length?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 您能确认这项例外是否涵盖我的国籍、目的地和准确过境时长吗？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Can payment records and appointment messages replace my missing original receipt?
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 没有原始回执时，付款记录和预约信息能否证明同一段办理历史？

cross-border-document-continuity.term: Once my identity record is corrected, please explain which linked reservations update automatically.
cross-border-document-continuity.meaningZh: 身份记录更正后，请说明哪些关联预订会自动更新。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Which option costs less after adding cancellation fees, transfers, meals, and one extra night?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 算上取消费、接送、餐食和额外一晚后，哪个方案总成本更低？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: The cheaper replacement hotel requires two inaccessible transfers.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 替代酒店更便宜，但前往那里需要两次无障碍条件不足的换乘。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Could you compare arrival times if I take the night train instead of another flight?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 如果我改乘夜车而不是另一班飞机，您能比较到达时间吗？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Can you relocate us from the unavailable room together with our luggage?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 我的房间无法入住，您能安排搬迁并确保我们不与行李分开吗？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Although the shuttle is complimentary, its final departure is before my delayed arrival.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 虽然接驳车免费，但末班车早于我延误后的抵达时间。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Would the rail pass remain worthwhile if seat reservations and airport transfers cost extra?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 如果座位预订和机场接送需要另付费，铁路通票还划算吗？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: The longer direct bus avoids carrying bags through three stations.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 直达巴士耗时更长，但可以避免拖着行李穿过三个车站。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Please compare refundable rates with flexible rates after including breakfast and local transport.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 请在计入早餐和当地交通后，比较可退款房价与灵活房价。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: If I accept the substitute room, which original benefits and conditions will remain?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 如果我接受替代房间，原预订中的哪些权益和条件会保留？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Could the property hold our luggage while we inspect the proposed alternative nearby?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 我们查看附近的替代住宿时，酒店可以暂时保管行李吗？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: The spacious apartment competes with the hotel's reliable late-night reception.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 公寓空间更大，而酒店能提供可靠的深夜接待服务。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: What evidence should I save before paying for transport caused by the relocation?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 在支付因搬迁产生的交通费用前，我应该保留哪些证明？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Since the station lift is closed, which route has the fewest unavoidable stairs?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 由于车站电梯关闭，哪条路线不可避免的楼梯最少？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: A later departure reduces stress, but it would forfeit our prepaid first night.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 晚些出发压力更小，但会损失已经预付的第一晚住宿。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Can you place both alternatives in writing with total prices and realistic transfer times?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 您能书面列出两个替代方案的总价和实际换乘时间吗？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: The replacement train is faster, provided our tickets remain valid through the changed route.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 替代列车更快，前提是我们的车票在改线后仍然有效。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Would splitting the journey overnight provide better reliability than waiting for one connection?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 中途住一晚分段出行，会不会比等待一次转乘更可靠？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: My accessible room was changed; does the alternative include the same bathroom features?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 我的无障碍房间被更换了，替代房是否具备相同的浴室设施？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: If the operator refuses reimbursement, where should I submit receipts and disruption notices?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 如果运营方拒绝报销，我应该在哪里提交收据和中断通知？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: The airport hotel saves time, although its cancellation window has already passed.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 机场酒店可以节省时间，但它的取消期限已经过了。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Could one provider coordinate the room, transfer, and revised departure instead of separate bookings?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 能否由一家服务商统一协调房间、接送和更改后的出发安排？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Before choosing, I need the walking distance between each platform, stop, and entrance.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 选择之前，我需要知道各站台、车站和入口之间的步行距离。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: This fare includes a bed, while the cheaper option requires sitting overnight.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 这个票价包含卧铺，而更便宜的方案需要坐一整夜。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Does the proposed taxi price include waiting time if baggage delivery is delayed?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 如果行李送达延误，建议的出租车价格是否包含等待费用？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: The new property accepts pets, but its transport connection ends too early.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 新住宿允许携带宠物，但前往那里的交通结束得太早。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Could you preserve our original checkout time despite moving us after midnight?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 尽管我们在午夜后才被安排搬迁，能否保留原来的退房时间？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: If we travel separately, how will the booking protect both passengers during disruption?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 如果我们分开出行，预订将如何保障两位乘客在中断期间的安排？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: The longer route appears safer because every connection has a recovery alternative.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 较长的路线似乎更稳妥，因为每次换乘都有备用方案。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Please show which extra costs are confirmed and which remain only estimates.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 请说明哪些额外费用已经确认，哪些目前只是估算。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Our booking includes dinner, whereas the substitute property closes its kitchen before arrival.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 我们的预订包含晚餐，而替代住宿的厨房在抵达前就关闭了。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Can the unused segment become credit if I choose the more reliable itinerary?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 如果我选择更可靠的行程，未使用的路段能否转为余额？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: The coach allows more luggage, but its drop-off point is far from the accommodation.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 长途汽车允许携带更多行李，但下车点离住宿很远。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: If neither option meets the accessibility requirement, what comparable solution can you arrange?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 如果两个方案都不符合无障碍要求，您能安排什么同等替代方案？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: The first proposal is convenient, although its change fee could increase without notice.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 第一个方案很方便，但更改费可能在未通知的情况下上涨。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Would booking each part separately improve flexibility or weaken our disruption protection?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 分别预订各段会提高灵活性，还是会削弱行程中断保障？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Keep every replacement confirmation together so the additional expenses remain easy to trace.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 请把所有替代安排确认放在一起，以便清楚追溯额外费用。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: What happens to my return journey if I accept this one-way replacement?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 如果我接受这段单程替代安排，我的返程将受到什么影响？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: A nearby hostel solves tonight's problem, but it cannot accommodate our entire stay.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 附近的旅舍能解决今晚的问题，但无法接待我们整个住宿期间。

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: Could the missed-night value offset the upgrade required at the replacement property?
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 损失的一晚费用能否抵扣替代住宿所需的升级费用？

accommodation-transport-solution-compari.term: After comparing both plans, please reserve the safer option while preserving our refund request.
accommodation-transport-solution-compari.meaningZh: 比较两个方案后，请预留更稳妥的选择，同时保留我们的退款申请。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Does my policy cover follow-up treatment abroad after emergency care begins in transit?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 我的保险是否涵盖在途中开始急救后于境外进行的后续治疗？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: The clinic can stabilize me today, but another facility must provide continuing care.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 这家诊所今天可以稳定我的病情，但后续治疗必须由另一家机构提供。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Before transferring hospitals, which records should travel with me to prevent repeated tests?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 转院前，哪些病历应随我转交，以避免重复检查？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: My prescription uses a brand unavailable here; what equivalent can the pharmacist safely supply?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 我的处方药品牌在这里没有，药剂师可以安全提供哪种等效药？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: If prior approval arrives late, will treatment already received remain eligible for reimbursement?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 如果事先批准来得较晚，已经接受的治疗还能申请报销吗？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Could the insurer send payment confirmation directly so the hospital does not delay discharge?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 保险公司能否直接发送付款确认，以免医院延误出院？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: The doctor recommends flying later, although my policy limits extra accommodation coverage.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 医生建议推迟飞行，但我的保单限制了额外住宿保障。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Which medical summary will help my regular doctor continue treatment after I return?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 哪份医疗摘要能帮助我的常规医生在我回国后继续治疗？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Because the diagnosis changed, please update both the treatment plan and insurance reference.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 由于诊断发生变化，请同时更新治疗方案和保险编号。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Would remote consultation preserve continuity until I can reach an approved specialist?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 在我能见到认可的专科医生前，远程会诊能否维持治疗连续性？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: The pharmacy dispensed fewer tablets; how should I document the remaining prescribed amount?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 药房少发了药片，我该如何记录处方中尚未发放的数量？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: If this facility is outside the network, what comparable nearby provider is covered?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 如果这家机构不在保险网络内，附近哪家同等级机构可以获得保障？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: My medical letter explains the restriction, but the airline requires a different format.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 我的医疗证明解释了限制，但航空公司要求使用另一种格式。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Can the hospital separate medically necessary charges from optional services on the invoice?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 医院能否在账单上区分医疗必需费用和可选服务费用？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: I need enough medication for the delay without exceeding local dispensing limits.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 我需要足够应对延误的药量，但不能超过当地配药限制。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: What evidence connects the emergency visit, specialist referral, and later rehabilitation sessions?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 哪些证明可以把急诊就诊、专科转诊和后续康复治疗关联起来？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Although symptoms improved, the physician advises monitoring before I continue traveling alone.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 虽然症状有所改善，但医生建议先观察再让我独自继续旅行。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Could you compare treatment here with transfer costs and risks at the approved hospital?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 您能比较在这里治疗与转往认可医院的费用和风险吗？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: The claim portal rejected my receipt; which missing detail should the clinic add?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 理赔平台拒绝了我的收据，诊所需要补充哪项缺失信息？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: If I interrupt treatment to travel, could that affect coverage for the same condition?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 如果我中断治疗去旅行，会影响同一病情的后续保障吗？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Please record the generic drug name, dosage, and reason for any substitution.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 请记录药物通用名、剂量以及任何替换用药的原因。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: My insurer approved imaging, yet the hospital scheduled a test with a different code.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 保险公司批准了影像检查，但医院安排的检查代码不同。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Would an interpreter join the consent discussion without receiving unrelated medical information?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 口译员能否参加知情同意沟通，同时不接触无关医疗信息？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: The discharge note omits my allergy, which the next clinic must know immediately.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 出院记录漏掉了我的过敏史，而下一家诊所必须立即知道。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Where can I appeal the rejected transport cost recommended by the treating physician?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 治疗医生建议的交通费用被拒绝后，我可以在哪里申诉？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Since my return flight changed, how do I extend coverage without restarting the policy?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 由于返程航班改变，我该如何延长保障而不重新购买保单？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: The specialist is available tomorrow, whereas the approved clinic can only see me next week.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 专科医生明天有空，而保险认可的诊所下周才能接诊。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Can the assistance service coordinate medication storage during the hotel transfer?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 援助服务能否协调我在酒店转移期间的药品储存？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: If complications develop after discharge, which provider should receive the first update?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 如果出院后出现并发症，应该先通知哪家医疗机构？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: The invoice combines two visits, but my claim requires separate dates and treatments.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 发票合并了两次就诊，但我的理赔需要分别列出日期和治疗内容。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Could you preserve the original scan while securely sending a copy to my home doctor?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 您能保留原始扫描资料，同时安全地把副本发给我的家庭医生吗？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: My condition permits rail travel, provided assistance and medication remain available throughout.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 我的病情允许乘火车，前提是全程有协助并能获得药物。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: What happens if the approved treatment ends before I am medically fit to return?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 如果获批治疗结束时我仍不适合返程，会怎样处理？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Rather than repeat the examination, can the new doctor review translated results first?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 与其重复检查，新医生能否先查看翻译后的结果？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: The insurer needs clinical justification, while the clinic has only supplied a payment receipt.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 保险公司需要临床说明，而诊所目前只提供了付款收据。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Please identify which follow-up visits require new approval and which remain under this case.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 请说明哪些复诊需要重新批准，哪些仍归入本次案件。

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Does the coverage exception include chronic conditions worsened by an unexpected travel delay?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 保障例外是否包括因意外旅行延误而加重的慢性病？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: If the medication causes side effects, who can revise the prescription after hours?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 如果药物引起副作用，非工作时间由谁调整处方？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Once the claim is corrected, how will reimbursement reach me while I remain abroad?
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 理赔信息更正后，我仍在国外时将如何收到报销款？

medical-insurance-care-continuity.term: Keep the referral, authorization, invoices, and discharge summary linked under one case number.
medical-insurance-care-continuity.meaningZh: 请把转诊单、授权、发票和出院摘要关联到同一个案件编号下。
